_readme: Metadata and analytics configuration for the HelloBoe marketing site.
Edit this file, then run `npm run build:staging` from the repo root.
Nothing here is secret. The gate password is passed separately via the
HELLOBOE_STAGING_PASSWORD environment variable and is never committed.
_launched: false  = the site is the invite-only preview at /staging.
The gate page is noindex/nofollow and carries a deliberately
uninformative title, so a stray link leaks nothing.
true   = the site is public. Full SEO metadata, indexable, canonical at
the site root. Flip this in the same change that removes the gate.
title: HelloBoe | Your child, decoded.
description: Temperament science meets real parenting. A parenting app built to understand the child you actually have, for ages 4 to 36 months.

_enabled: MUST STAY false until counsel updates the privacy policy. The live
policy states the website 'does not currently set advertising or
analytics cookies', that we 'do not permit third-party advertising
networks to collect information through the Services', and that any
future advertising use requires updating the policy FIRST (the
policy's own clause). Flipping this true before the revised
legal/source/privacy.json lands publishes a tag the policy says we
_consent: When enabled, the tag is emitted with Consent Mode v2 defaults DENYING
ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization and analytics_storage: no
cookies are ever set; Google receives cookieless conversion pings and
models the rest. Deliberate (privacy-first brand, no consent banner).
Do not upgrade to cookie-based tracking without counsel sign-off.

_provider: 2026-06-30, consent version 2.0) states in the Automatically Collected
Information section: 'Our marketing and policy website does not
currently set advertising or analytics cookies.'
Plausible and Fathom are cookieless and store nothing in the browser,
so that published statement stays true and no consent banner is
required. Google Analytics would contradict it outright. Mixpanel's
web SDK sets a cookie by default and would need both a config override
OPEN ITEM: the policy names Mixpanel, RevenueCat and Sentry
individually in its Who We Share Your Information With section. Add
the analytics vendor named here to that list at the next policy
revision. Not a re-consent event, but it should not be skipped.
_enabled: The tag is emitted now and points at helloboe.com. Until the Plausible
account exists the script simply fails to load and nothing is
collected anywhere, so this is safe to leave on. Creating the account
activates it with no code change and no redeploy.
Set false to remove the tag entirely.
_trackWhileGated: The tag lives inside the encrypted payload, so it only ever runs after
someone has entered the password. Gate visits are never counted.
Set false to strip analytics entirely until `launched` is true.
